title: Quantum Vault: Symmetric No-Cloning Protection for Token Issuer and User (Benchmarked on IBMQ)
summary: Quantum tokens are underlying primitives for quantum money and network proposals, which leverage the no-cloning theorem to realize unforgeable authentication. A relevant but overlooked type of attack to such architectures is one in which a hacker steals the classical side information about the token states from the issuing agent (e.g., a bank), enabling the forgery of fake tokens without violating the no-cloning theorem.
